definitions.explanation: Lacking any flavor, charm, or emotional appeal; tediously uninteresting.

examples.japanese: {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な{文章|ぶんしょう}。
{報告書|ほうこくしょ}は{無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な{内容|ないよう}だった。
examples.english: The report had dry, uninteresting content.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{同|おな}じことの{繰|く}り{返|かえ}しで、{無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}っている。
examples.english: Every day is the same thing repeated, and I'm living a dull, colorless life.

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) meaning literally 'without flavor and dried out.' Used figuratively — never literally about food. Describes writing, speeches, daily life, or anything that lacks emotional richness or interest. Used as a na-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な{生活|せいかつ}: a dull, uneventful life
- {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な{話|はなし}: a dry, boring talk
- {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な{説明|せつめい}: a bland explanation
- {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な{日々|ひび}: tedious days

SIMILAR WORDS:
- つまらない: boring; uninteresting — everyday word; broader in application
- {退屈|たいくつ}: boredom; tedium — focuses on the feeling of being bored rather than a quality of the thing itself
- {味気|あじけ}ない: dull; flat; dreary — similar literary register; implies a lack of warmth or emotional nourishment
- {単調|たんちょう}: monotonous — emphasizes repetitiveness rather than lack of substance
